comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
These should be dropped by the Ganador l'Olonnais, who appears during 17th Century, phase 3. (We're in phase 2 at the time of this posting.)

Green Version (dropped by Orange l'Ol):

+2 Plunder
+1 Swordplay

Purple Version (dropped by Red l'Ol):

+3 Plunder
+1 Swordplay
+1 Assault

images: 0maturi2ndage.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-264.html
17th Century Ganador drop table: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Ganador/17th century (note that certain drops may be subject to change on GAMA)
